summary: Frontend regression for Bracket batch 47 (boxed folder tabs, Activity redesign + filters, First-run checklist) fully verified. All acceptance criteria pass; no console errors on /app, /app/activity, or /project/:id.
critical_code_review_comments: Activity.jsx: WindowToggle refetches on toggle; consider caching per-window data client-side to avoid re-render flicker (non-blocking).

FirstRunChecklist.jsx uses a `tick` state that only forces a re-render (via `const _ = tick`); this is fragile — prefer reading localStorage flags into state on the `bracket-firstrun-update` event for clarity (non-blocking).
Activity project <option> value is the raw project_id; long IDs are fine, but consider truncation for a11y screen reader UX (non-blocking).
